== English Special Edition comparison ==
The original activates or retrieves Force cumulatively and places the Spaceport Speeders droid in the Used Pile. The Decipher replacement makes activation and retrieval alternative choices for a single use per game and removes the Used Pile instruction. Spaceport Speeders may still be played at the same site.
